content_sections.heading: Gram Panchayat Sachiv Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared according to the marks obtained in specified criteria, followed by a computer skill test. Higher Secondary (12th) marks weightage: 50 percent Higher educational qualification weightage: 10 marks (Graduation: 05 marks, Post-Graduation: 05 marks) Computer skill test marks weightage: 25 percent Rozgar Sahayak work experience weightage: 15 marks (03 marks per year up to maximum 05 years, 01 month to minimum 09 months of service) For every 01 post, 10 candidates will be called for the computer skill test based on merit. In case of a tie in merit, the older candidate in age will be given priority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gram Panchayat Sachiv
content_sections.text: Download the application form and notification from the official website kondagaon.gov.in or obtain it from the district panchayat and janpad panchayats. Fill out the application form in Hindi or English with the required details. Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form. Attach self-attested copies of all required educational certificates, mark sheets, residential certificate, caste certificate, and other supporting documents. Pack the application and documents securely in an envelope and write the name of the post applied for clearly on top of the envelope. Send the application via registered post or speed post only to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh, to reach by 27 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: 10th marksheet and certificate 12th (Higher Secondary) marksheet and certificate Graduation marksheet and certificate (if applicable) Post-Graduation marksheet and certificate (if applicable) One-year computer diploma certificate Permanent residential certificate issued by competent revenue authority Permanent caste certificate issued by competent authority Income certificate for OBC non-creamy layer issued within the last 03 years (if applicable) Rozgar Sahayak experience certificate issued by Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat with outward number and date, along with appointment order and NOC (if applicable) Disability certificate issued by the District Medical Board (if applicable) Ex-servicemen identity card issued by District Soldier Welfare Office (if applicable) NOC from employer if employed in government or semi-government service

Selected candidates will be placed on probation for a period of two years, which may be extended up to five years. The number of vacancies is subject to increase or decrease as per requirements. faq.question: Q1. What is District Panchayat Kondagaon Gram Panchayat Sachiv Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive conducted by District Panchayat Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh, to fill 65 vacancies for the post of Gram Panchayat Sachiv on a regular pay scale.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 65 vacancies available for the Gram Panchayat Sachiv post across various categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Kondagaon Gram Panchayat Sachiv recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications by registered or speed post is 27 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Gram Panchayat Sachiv?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary Board Examination (12th) and possess a one-year diploma in Data Entry Operator or Programming from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The applicant's age must be between 18 and 35 years as on the date of publication of the advertisement, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. How should I submit my application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be filled in the prescribed format and sent along with self-attested documents via registered post or speed post to the Office of Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Kondagaon.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list prepared from Higher Secondary marks, higher educational qualifications, computer skill test marks, and Rozgar Sahayak work experience, followed by a computer skill test.

faq.question: Q9. Is the job location restricted to Kondagaon?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must be permanent residents of Kondagaon district, and selected candidates will serve within Kondagaon district.
